title: bookwright check --json output
description: Single JSON document emitted to stdout by `bookwright check --json`. Iteration 001-repo-bootstrap, schema v0.0.1.

ok.description: Aggregate verdict. True iff every entry in `checks` has status == 'ok'. The process exit code is 0 when ok == true, non-zero (1) otherwise.

checks.description: Ordered list of individual check results. Order matches execution order; non-empty by construction (the python_version check always runs).

name.description: Stable identifier for the check. Convention: 'python_version' for the interpreter version check; 'dependency:<module_name>' for each declared runtime dependency import probe.

detail.description: Human-readable extra context. Required convention: present when status == 'fail' (describes the failure). May be present when status == 'ok' (e.g. the Python version string for the python_version check).
